method: Five representative placements/approach positions × three current silo variants × Walker/DuneTread/TwinFan, one at a time; B1–B3 additionally probe launches only24units before exit. Production EnemyPreview gait, MissilePreview admission, boost/coast/committed-intercept guidance, swept contact and fixed claims;1/120-second steps. Every other launch is disabled. Very late Walker/Fan flights are discarded when the existing development actor wraps its route; this is a timing limitation, not a campaign exit rule. A hit demonstrates that finite placement/trajectory, not all positions/times. Committed-intercept corner misses may be valid outcomes and do not justify scenery removal.
